'''Wildra Selin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], training other agents in the arts of combat and espionage on the Imperial capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
